<description>
In `Consensus::CheckTxInputs`, the inputs are invalid if, for every input coin, either `coin.out.nValue` or `nValueIn` is out of range. However, the current `checktxinputs_invalid_transactions_test` only covers cases with one input, so the sum `nValueIn` is always equal to `coin.out.nValue`, leaving the [following mutant](https://mutanthub.space/mutants/275) alive.
```diff
--- a/src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp
+++ b/src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp
@@ -189,7 +189,7 @@ bool Consensus::CheckTxInputs(const CTransaction& tx, TxValidationState& state,

         // Check for negative or overflow input values
         nValueIn += coin.out.nValue;
-        if (!MoneyRange(coin.out.nValue) || !MoneyRange(nValueIn)) {
+        if (!MoneyRange(coin.out.nValue) && !MoneyRange(nValueIn)) {
             return state.Invalid(TxValidationResult::TX_CONSENSUS, "bad-txns-inputvalues-outofrange");
         }
     }
```
https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36686/commits/f8c6cd84e08043f206ca338d0ba7e4dc8bef5214 adds support for multiple inputs in the test helper.

https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36686/commits/133714d1695bc40277b213afd252c3e320cac73e adds a test case with multiple valid inputs, whose sum exceed `MAX_MONEY`, while also having `nValueIn` != `coin.out.nValue`, killing the mutant.
</description>
